Synthetic RoadGuard H2 engineering fixture, version 1.
This is a constructed mathematical example, not measured project data or a CRS authority.
Coordinates are canonical E/N metres in a custom local plane, with SRID 0 bound to an explicit profile revision.
LINE: (0,0) to (200,0), analytic length 200 metres.
ARC: centre (200,100), radius 100 metres, start angle -pi/2, signed sweep +pi/2,
     from (200,0) to (300,100), analytic length 100*pi/2 metres.
The two tangents meet continuously. Total analytic length is 200+50*pi metres.
Road width 12 metres, survey width 20 metres. Equal strips of 4 or 6 metres divide exactly; 5 does not.
There is no datum transform, official VN2000 parameter set, accuracy claim, independent survey control or sourced acceptance tolerance.
Rendering tolerance is an explicit caller-selected display approximation, unrelated to survey accuracy.
